title: Design: Payer page on a phone shows Pays for and Bill Invoices To
custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • Use a phone, or a browser window 390 pixels wide, signed in as an Admin at the test location.
  • Have customer A billing customer D by default, and customer A saved as customer B's Bill Invoices To, so one customer is the other's saved payer.
  • Open the attached pictures bt-p5-15-after-phone.png, bt-p5-14-before-phone.png at 100% zoom beside the screen.
custom_expected:
Expected Result

Step 1:

  • The card shows Bill Invoices To with customer D's name and Change on one line, and three counters: Contacts, Assets and Pays for (blue).

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

From: PRD "Bill To", Confluence 1003585538, version 0.5 (6 Nov 2026, pending approval, Chris Ward), read 9 Nov 2026 · Epic SV-12289, story SV-12303 (Story 1, Saved default Bill To on the customer page)

  • S1-R1: “When a default other than the customer itself is saved, the customer page left card shows "Bill Invoices To" with the payer's name.”
  • S1-R7: “When at least one customer has this customer as its default, the card shows a "Pays for" counter beside Contacts and Assets, with the count.”

The build is not yet available to check this case against.

References from Design

Design canvas "Bill To design" (https://claude.ai/artifact/2prSHgwt2tWCz96QD2DWkd), version 1794239066-4906, read 9 Nov 2026: page "5 Getting paid", pictures "Phone" (This build), "Phone" (Production (v26.45.2.1)).
